title: Harvester Release Catalog
description: Top-level index of a finalized Harvester release. One catalog.json per release, located at <release_root>/catalog.json.

schema_version.description: Catalog schema version, MAJOR.MINOR. Phase 2 freezes at 1.0.

harvester_version.description: Semantic version of the Harvester package that produced this release.

release_id.description: Release identifier of the form YYYY-MM-DD-rN. Must match the parent directory name.

finalized_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC, with timezone designator) of finalization.

host.description: Hostname or identifier of the machine that produced the release.

operator.description: Identifier of the human or automated agent that triggered finalization.

git_commit.description: Git commit hash of the Harvester repo at finalization time, if available.

producer.description: Optional metadata about the agent that produced the release. Recommended for audit.

datasets.description: List of datasets included in this release. May be empty for a 'mechanism-only' release with no data.

supersedes.description: Optional list of release_ids this release intends to supersede. Informational only; superseded releases remain available and immutable.

notes.description: Free-form release notes. Not consumed programmatically.

dataset_id.description: Stable identifier of the dataset, dot-separated lowercase tokens. Stable across releases.

dataset_revision.description: Revision number within this release. Typically 1. Increment only if multiple revisions of the same dataset_id exist within one release (rare).

manifest_path.description: Path to the manifest file, relative to the release root.

data_path.description: Path to the data file, relative to the release root.

provenance_path.description: Path to the provenance file, relative to the release root.

quality_report_path.description: Optional path to a quality report, relative to the release root.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the dataset for catalog browsing. Not authoritative; refer to the manifest for full metadata.
